Half a bagel with cream cheese on a square plate about 26 cm across. The bagel half spans roughly 8×10 cm, so it is a small bagel half of about 45 g (about 120 kcal). The cream cheese layer looks like about 25 g (about 85 kcal). That gives roughly 70 g of food and about 205 kcal in total.
